dialogues.text_zh: 那正好啊，我也覺得發洩得不夠過癮呢。慾望這種東西，總是越放蕩越是膨脹♥

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Haha, then get ready—tonight, you're in for the grandest display of "milky fireworks" yet!
dialogues.text_zh: 哈哈，那接下來就請妳好好欣賞，今晚最盛大的「白濁煙火」吧！

role_voices.text_zh: 哈哈！又見面了，我們真是有緣分啊！
role_voices.text_en: Haha! We meet again—what a coincidence! I guess we're really destined to keep running into each other!

role_voices.text_zh: 邪惡的本質是慾望，但慾望並非邪惡。邪惡，不過是慾望的一種結果罷了。
role_voices.text_en: The essence of evil is desire, but desire itself is not evil. Evil is simply one possible outcome of desire.

role_voices.text_zh: 我非常喜歡旅行，因為它能讓我…看到更多人世間的醜惡。哈哈！
role_voices.text_en: I really love traveling, because it lets me... see more of the ugliness in the world. Haha!

role_voices.text_zh: 雅典娜太認真了，她都忘了適時地發洩慾望。呵，說白了，就是個悶騷女。
role_voices.text_en: Athena takes things too seriously—she's forgotten how to let off steam and indulge her desires from time to time. Heh, to put it bluntly, she's a little pent up.

role_voices.text_zh: 人生處處都是選擇。遵從自己的慾望、自由地選擇，然後活下去吧，潘朵拉！
role_voices.text_en: Life is full of choices. Follow your desires, choose freely, and keep on living, Pandora!

role_voices.text_zh: 這世界上沒有人是真正自由的，即使是你跟我，魔王。
role_voices.text_en: No one in this world is truly free—not even you or me, Archfiend.

role_voices.text_zh: 遇見你真是太好了，魔王。只有在你面前，我才能展露出……內心最深層的渴望。
role_voices.text_en: I'm so glad I met you, Archfiend. Only in front of you can I reveal… the deepest desires of my heart.

role_voices.text_zh: 真是懷念那一晚酣暢淋漓的洩慾呢……今晚要不要來回味一下呢？魔王♥
role_voices.text_en: I really miss that night of unrestrained pleasure... How about we relive it tonight? Archfiend♥

role_voices.text_zh: 啊啊……！太棒了！果然只有這根、粗壯的肉棒，嗯嗯♥能滿足內心的飢渴——！
role_voices.text_en: Aaah...! Amazing! I knew it—only this thick, hard cock can really satisfy the hunger deep inside me... mmmh ♥

role_voices.text_zh: 自由，這就是我的戰鬥方式！

role_voices.text_en: It's time for all of this to end!

role_voices.text_zh: 勝利！讓我們回去大肆慶祝吧！……就你跟我♥
role_voices.text_en: Victory! Let's go back and have a huge celebration! ...Just you and me♥
